insights: Erdos65OQ03.lean formalizes the Liu-Montgomery sharp constant (1/2 - o(1)) · log d for cycle-length reciprocal sums (JAMS 2023, 43 pages)
The constant 1/2 arises because complete bipartite graphs K_{m,m} are the extremal minimizers — they have only even-length cycles, and even cycles of length 2j contribute 1/(2j) = (1/2)(1/j)
Key definitions: partialHarmonic (H(m)), partialHarmonicFrom2 (shifted Σ_{j=2}^m 1/j), evenHarmonic (Σ 1/(2j) = H/2), bipartiteCycleRecipSum (cycle sum for K_{r,s})

The single axiom `liu_montgomery_sharp` carries the deep ε(d) → 0 statement; structural lemmas (evenHarmonic_eq_half_harmonic, bipartiteCycleRecipSum_eq_half_shifted, bipartite_is_even, sharp_constant_achieved) and concrete instantiations (partialHarmonic_four, evenHarmonic_four, evenCycleSum_four) are all proved without sorry
